headline: You're already inside my heart, but I still verify every move. My policy is ZERO TRUST.
caption:
You're already inside my heart, but I still verify every move. My policy is ZERO TRUST.

—
ZERO TRUST: nothing is trusted by default, even from inside the network; every request is checked.
